# expandRepeatInstances

## Summary

Expands one declared part into N placed copies (count capped at 48): `linear` mode steps each clone by `offset`, `radial` mode carries clones rigidly around a ring — the orbital spin composes OUTSIDE the part's own orientation so pre-aimed parts stay parallel, and the ring centre comes from the declared host's bounding box rather than the part's own position (which would double the radius). Index 0 re-places the original itself so it sits on its own ring. Written as a hoisting declaration with no module-level references and no `?.`/`??`, because its source is emitted verbatim into exported models.

## Import

```ts
import { expandRepeatInstances } from '../util/repeat-expand';
```

## Usage

This is the ONE implementation: `../util/code-export` emits it via `Function.prototype.toString()` into every generated model .js that uses `repeat`, so the studio viewport and standalone exports array parts identically — hand-copied twins drifted once.
